title: Holiday layers
description: Layers of holidays as read by HolidayFormat.json(). A layer adds holidays, overrides or removes inherited ones by name, and may declare a weekend, an observance rule and the layer it extends.

id.description: Unique name, ISO 3166-1 or 3166-2 where one exists (ES, ES-AN), free text below that (ES-AN-MA).

extends.description: The id of the layer this one builds on.

weekend.description: Replaces the weekend in force from this layer up.

observance.description: Replaces the observance rule in force from this layer up. INHERIT is not allowed here.

holidays.description: Holidays added by this layer. A name a lower layer defines must go in override or remove instead.

override.description: Holidays replacing the inherited ones of the same name.

remove.description: Names of inherited holidays this layer drops.

from.description: First year the holiday is in force, inclusive.

until.description: Last year the holiday is in force, inclusive.

observance.description: Overrides the layer rule for this holiday only.

closesAt.description: Closing time of a HALF_DAY; sets the type to HALF_DAY. Noon when absent.

rule.description: Exactly one kind: fixed, date, easter, nth (with weekday and month), weekdayAfter or weekdayBefore (with base), hijri, hebrew.

date.description: One date, YYYY-MM-DD; the holiday occurs in that year only.

easter.description: Days from Easter Sunday; negative before.

nth.description: 1 to 5 from the start of the month, -1 to -5 from the end.

hijri.description: Islamic month and day, MM-DD, Umm al-Qura tables.

hebrew.description: Hebrew month name and day, for example NISAN-15. ADAR is Adar II in a leap year; ADAR_I exists only in leap years.
